programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur

Then, dive deep under the sea to learn the ABCs with jellyfish and shark friends and swim like a beautiful mermaid! The adventure continues deep in the jungle where you can dance with gorillas, snakes and crocodiles. From popping bubbles to doing a silly animal dance, it's a wild party at the beach and in the jungle!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Come on and join JJ's fun learning club! The adventure starts with a field trip to the farm where JJ and his friends learn to count to ten using apples. The learning continues in the classroom as Ms. Appleberry sends the kids on a scavenger hunt to find items in every color of the rainbow. Even lunchtime is fun, as the family finds all the different shapes in JJ's lunch! From taking care of pets to learning yoga, there's always something new to learn!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a messy guest, a cracked egg, a hoppy friend and a ruined teddy! Jeff meets a cute but very messy Floofer and has to learn to live with his new friend's untidy habits. Then, Lulu finds a colorful egg, and when it cracks, a cute chick hatches that she doesn't want to let go! The challenges continue as Newt tries to nurse an injured Oddfrog back to health and Pogo feels guilty after accidentally ruining Newt's teddy bear-shaped hedge.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: It's a day of yummy adventures with fruits, cupcakes, snacks and ice cream! Pogo wants to pick a delicious fruit from a tree, but he hilariously learns that he has to be patient and wait for it to ripen! Then, Lulu is determined to bake a cupcake all by herself, but her mixture turns into a giant cupcake blob that takes over the Playpod! Plus, Fuse is craving a snack but can't get the box open and Pogo's ice cream keeps melting!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Watch out, because these cute creatures are causing big chaos! First, Chroma the Magic Pet has a cold, and every time she sneezes, she causes a huge color splat! Mila and Morphle must find her before the whole city is covered in color. Then, the Baby Morphles arrive from another dimension and they are in the mood for a game of chase! From a giant living doll to a runaway magic pet, these cute creatures are causing chaos everywhere!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle may be small, but they're tiny heroes on giant-sized adventures! When a hamster gets stuck in a colorful cardboard maze, a rescue mission begins! Mila and Morphle get shrunk to hamster size and go into the maze to find their little furry pal. Then, when a whale gets stranded on the beach, the friends shrink it to get it back to the ocean. But when Winston races away with the tiny whale, the chase is on!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Baby John has so many fun questions to ask! While playing in the garden, he asks his parents why some things are the way they are, like why his feet stink and why bubbles pop! Then, when Mom mistakenly takes his favorite hat to the laundry, he has to ask his family for help finding it. The questions continue as Jack and Jill help him figure out which of his toys will float or sink in the water.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John for some imagination and problem-solving fun! Oh no, Teddy is missing! But don't worry, Mom, Dad, Jack and Jill are all there to help Baby John search for him and solve the mystery. Then, dressed as pigs, Baby John, Jack and Jill use their imagination to re-enact the classic 'Three Little Pigs' story, with Dad playing the Big Bad Wolf! The problem-solving continues as the family helps guide Jill through the experience of losing her first tooth.

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Cody for a day filled with all his favorite things! First, Cody gets to live out his dino dreams as he dons a dinosaur costume and pretends to be a monster attacking a toy bridge. The fun continues at school, where he starts playing a guitar and his classmates join in to form their very own rock band! Cody also shows his caring side as he and his friends encounter a lost baby duckling and lead the way to help it find the perfect home.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Spend a fun-filled day in the life of JJ and his friends! First, Ms. Appleberry takes the Melon Patch kids on a beach field trip to learn about different types of vehicles. Then, JJ gets to bring a special guest to class: his dog, Bingo! Everyone has a great time as Bingo plays, snacks and even saves the day! The adventure continues at the farm, where JJ and Grandpa have to wrangle all the baby animals after they escape from their pen!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Use your imagination at JJ's big pretend play dance party! Join Cody, Nina and Bella as they pretend to explore all sorts of fun places, from outer space to the bottom of the ocean. The fun continues as everyone learns how to do the robot dance to a beep-boop beat! Then, get into your pajamas for a slumber party where you can jump, wiggle and shuffle. With fun exercise moves and graceful ballet steps, it's a dance party where you can be anything you want!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: There are so many fun things to discover with Mia, Max and their friends! First, they head to the park for some rolling fun as they play Jack and Jill, rolling down the muddy grass and whizzing down the slide! Then, Max gets his first sippy cup and is so excited to show it off that he starts an impromptu tea party with all his playmates. The day of discovery ends with a rainy day competition to see who can make the biggest puddle splash of all!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for a big playtime sing-along with Mia and Max! First, they play a fun fishing game in the garden with Mummy and Daddy, learning their colors as they catch different colored fish. Then, Mia and Maple learn to play together by setting up a super cute tea party with all their cuddly toys. The playtime fun continues as Mia and Max pretend to be puppies, crawling and barking while singing the classic song 'BINGO!' with their parents.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He and D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety and how a crane works. Then, they meet Frankie the Firetruck to see all of her amazing fire-fighting abilities in action! After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car and a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as his amazing dreams come to life! First, he dreams he is a fish, complete with a tail and fins! He's scared when he meets a big shark, but soon learns the shark just wants a friend to play with. Then, it's all stations go as Buster dreams he's a space rocket and blasts off to tour all the planets! The dreams continue as he becomes Sheriff Buster in the wild west and finds a magic spell book that causes all sorts of trouble!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as he uses his brains to save the day! When he overloads the carwash with bubble mix, he gets trapped in a giant bubble and floats away! He has to use all his smarts to find a way back down. Then, when Amber the Ambulance crashes and can't move, there's a big emergency! Buster has to muster up his courage and become a 'Hero Ambulance Bus' to save his best friend Scout from a broken bridge.

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Get ready for sky-high and super fun adventures with JJ and his friends! First, Astronauts JJ and Mimi blast off into space, soaring past stars and planets before landing on the moon for a cheesy snack! When Boba loses his special balloon, the friends set off in a hot air balloon craft for a chase of a lifetime. The action continues as JJ and Wally train to be firefighters, but Wally's goofing around turns him into the one who needs saving!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Go on a big animal adventure with JJ! The fun starts on Grandpa's farm, where JJ learns all about the animals and the sounds they make. He even helps give a sheep a bath! Then, it's time to head to the ocean. Join JJ and his family as they visit an aquarium and sing 'Baby Shark' with a real shark family! The adventure gets prehistoric when Ms. Appleberry teaches the class all about their favorite dinosaurs. From guessing games to meeting Bingo the dog, it's a wild day!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Join JJ for a dance party in a magical dreamland! Blast off to outer space to sing and dance among the stars with a friendly Bunny Astronaut. Then, travel to imaginary lands to party with magical friends like unicorns and mermaids! The adventure continues as you stomp your feet and snap your claws along with dinosaurs to the 'Snap, Snap, Snap' song. With fun copy-me dances and beautiful ballet moves, it's a dance party beyond your wildest dreams!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Get ready for epic rescues and Mr. Weasel's hilarious fails! The chaos begins when Weasel fills Max the Monster Truck's tires with helium, causing him to float away and forcing Gecko to perform a sky-high rescue! Then, Weasel's plan to give Molly extra bouncy springs goes wrong, and Gecko has to help her stop bouncing. The rescues continue when Weasel's new electro-magnet sucks up Baby Truck and the Mechanicals, and Gecko has to save the day!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's always a busy day at Gecko's Garage! The fun starts when Fiona the Fire Truck arrives with a broken hose that needs a clever fix. Then, Baby Truck comes in after playing in muddy puddles and needs a trip through the car wash machine. The day gets even busier with a late-night emergency wheel change for Bobby, which Gecko must do without waking up the sleeping Mechanicals! Plus, the Mechs have to work as a team when Gecko is feeling unwell.

programme.title: Rob the Robot
programme.desc: Join Rob and his friends for a tricky picnic and a trip to the lost and found! The gang heads to the Comet Cake Planet for dessert, but there's only one cake left and a greedy alien robot steals it! Then, the crew goes to the Picnic Planet for a picnic, but their food begins to vanish into thin air! Finally, when Ema can't find her favorite moon boots, the crew departs for the Lost And Found Planet, but they all get lost in the giant piles of items!

programme.title: Rob the Robot
programme.desc: Join Rob the Robot and his friends on a cheesy, tricky and fun mission! First, Squeak is in need of a snack, so the crew travels to the Cheese Planet to find him the best snack ever! Then, Squeak is turned into a bunny rabbit by mistake during Rob's magic show! The friends have to travel to the Magic Planet to find a way to turn him back. The fun ends as the gang decides to travel to the Imagination Planet where they can each act out their favorite imaginary character.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns all about yummy food! First, he explores the world of vegetables and learns that they are not only delicious but also essential for staying strong and healthy. Then, the family has fun making and tasting all sorts of delicious and healthy fruit juices. The tasty adventure continues as the kids learn to make colorful popsicles with yummy fruits and Miss Hannah turns healthy fruit into fun animal faces!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on some big day out adventures! First, the family visits the zoo to see all the amazing animals, like elephants, monkeys and hippos! Then, it's Baby John's first time at the water park, where he has lots of fun with water squirters and wading pools. The adventure continues with a trip to a fun theme park, where the family enjoys the merry-go-round, bumper cars and yummy cotton candy!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house and needs to be stopped!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo and his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie and tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo and takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Get ready for chaos as Magical Pet powers run wild! First, Bubblebear creates so many bubbles that they join together and become a giant Bubble Monster that traps everyone! Then, when Shrubcub gets sick, Pet Port is invaded by wayward vines, and the friends have to race against time to get her some magic tea. The wild powers continue as Slushyseal turns buildings and cars into giant juice pops that start to melt all over town!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: It's a big day of trouble, all thanks to Orphle! First, he uses a Multicolour Cloner to make different colored clones of himself, and it's up to Mila and Morphle to track them all down before they cause too much chaos. Then, when the friends are playing in a cardboard castle, Orphle mistakenly thinks they don't want to play with him and attacks it! From stealing a treasure map to teaming up with Winston, Orphle is causing trouble all day!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: It's time to play at home with Baby John and the family! First, they get everything ready for a fun movie night in the backyard, complete with popcorn and a projector. Then, the kids make a crazy bubble machine that makes bubbles of all sizes and colors, but it gets a little out of control! The fun at home continues as the kids plan a surprise romantic dinner for Mom and Dad and create a sock puppet show!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns about all the things he can be when he grows up! His adventure starts with a school trip to the fire station, where the kids learn what to do in an emergency and how firefighters are true superheroes! Then, he learns about all the different community helpers, like police officers and doctors. The learning continues as he discovers all about traffic lights and road safety while playing with his new toy car.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: It's a day of learning lessons at parties and games! Pogo is invited to Jeff's party, but Pogo wants it to be energetic while Jeff wants it to be calm, so they must learn to compromise. Then, Newt is desperate to win a gold star at Fuse's gym challenges, but she keeps losing! She has to learn to persevere and not give up. The lessons continue as Lulu learns to wait her turn at a funfair and Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy greens.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a sick trick, a spider, a bump and a fly! First, Jeff is sick, but after he recovers, he misses the attention and pretends he's still unwell! Then, Fuse is woken up by spooky noises in the night and must put on a brave face for Lulu to investigate. His bravery is tested again when he finds a spider in his gym and doesn't know how to get it out. The chaos ends when Pogo can't sleep and has to deal with a very noisy fly!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Spend a whole day with JJ, from morning to night! Wake up and get ready with the family as JJ learns his morning routine. Then, it's off to a big adventure: JJ's first day of preschool! He's a little nervous, but he makes new friends and has lots of fun. After a full day of playing, it's time to get ready for bed. Mommy guides JJ through his nighttime routine of brushing his teeth, taking a bath and reading a story before he drifts off to sleep.

programme.title: Nina's Familia
programme.desc: Join Nina on some amazing adventures with her friends! When Nina challenges her school friends to a game of soccer, she imagines herself as a true soccer star playing in a giant stadium at the World Cup! Then, she visits Grandpa's farm where she proves to be an ace tractor driver who never leaves her friends behind. From learning to share a new firetruck to going on an epic chase to get back a lost surprise egg, it's always an adventure with Nina!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: What will Cody do today? Every day is a new adventure! He might move to a new house with his family and cat, Pickles. Or maybe he'll find a simple empty cardboard box and use his imagination to turn it into a turtle shell, a drum and a race car! He could go on a hike with JJ and race walnut sailboats, or stay home and sing the ABCs over a big pot of alphabet soup. With Cody, you never know what fun you'll have!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's a day of helping each other at Lellobee City Farm! When a mama songbird's eggs are about to hatch, Mei, Ella and Rishi build her a beautiful bird feeding table so she can take care of her new chicks. Then, when Heidi the Horse is feeling down in the dumps, Ella and all the friends put on a show and give her a big group hug to make her feel happy again! The helping continues as everyone learns the importance of sharing their veggies with a visiting gopher.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's time to sing, dance and play at Lellobee City Farm! The fun starts in the Boogie Barn where Grandma Mei teaches Ella, Rishi and all the cute animals a brand new alphabet song. Then, it's time to get active as Mei leads a high-energy exercise dance for all the kids and animals! The day ends with a fun 'who can make the biggest splash?' competition in the inflatable swimming pool, where even Pablo the pig and Heidi the horse join in!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest and lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, and the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation and Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for some construction chaos and clever fixes! First, Mr. Rubble is very tired and puts the plans on the board upside down, causing the crew to build a house upside down! Then, while building a roundabout, the crew finds some big old dinosaur bones! The chaos continues as a power cut stops all their machines, so they hook everything up to clean solar panels instead. From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to laugh as everything goes hilariously wrong for Kii and Yii and their friends! The chaos starts when Robot creates a jelly-making machine, but it goes haywire and he ends up stuck inside a giant wobbly jelly! Then, Princess Cat puts way too much soap in her washing machine, causing it to overflow and fill her entire castle with bubbles! From a wobbly tooth to a picky eater, it's one funny problem after another!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate teamwork and rescue special with Kii and Yii! The adventure begins when Princess Cat is flying her plane but gets in a sticky jammy mess, causing her to lose control! It's up to Kii and Yii to get her down safely. Then, the friends are playing near Princess Cat's castle when she accidentally falls down the well and needs to be rescued again! From helping Humpty Dumpty to rounding up runaway vegetables, Kii and Yii always save the day!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Dive into some underwater learning adventures with The Sharksons! First, join the sea friends as they swim through the alphabet to learn their ABCs. Then, explore the vibrant hues of Splashy Reef with a journey to learn all the shades of a beautiful rainbow. The learning continues with important daily routines! Sing along with Tucker the Turtle as he takes a bath and watch as Baby Grub eagerly learns the importance of dental care by brushing her big, sharp shark teeth!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: It's time to learn all about colors, shapes and numbers with Twinkle! First, learn how to count with Twinkle as she finds five balloons in the colors red, blue, green, yellow and purple! Then, join Twinkle and Sandy the Seagull to make sandcastles, learning different shapes like squares, triangles and circles. The learning continues as Twinkle and her friends build and count a beautiful tower of rainbow stones and discover the variety of shapes that clouds can take in the sky!

programme.title: Family Spy
programme.desc: Ep08 Daniel menyesaki ibunya menyembunyikan sesuatu. Roz pula menyelinap masuk pengkalan operasi Gagak Putih dan telah diserang. Roz berdepan dengan kesilapan masa silamnya sebagai seorang ibu, isteri dan ejen perisik, yang kini kembali untuk memusnahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Family Spy
programme.desc: Eps 01 Roz menjalani kehidupan normal sebagai seorang opah setelah pencen dari kerjaya lamanya iaitu ejen perisik. Suatu hari, cucunya Rin, telah menggodam satu permainan komputer dan dia dihubungi oleh seorang misteri dalam talian yang mengetahui identiti Rin. Roz mengesyaki sesuatu tidak kena, tapi malangnya Rin telah diculik oleh penjahat misteri tersebut sebelum Roz sempat bertindak.

programme.title: Family Spy
programme.desc: Ep02 Roz cuba menenangkan Indah yang risaukan Rin dan Daniel yang telah mulakan penyiasatan. Namun Daniel tidak mahu mendengar nasihat ibunya, Roz. Daniel dan Roz menggunakan cara berbeza untuk mencari Rin. Pihak polis menerima rakaman pesanan suara Rin.

programme.title: Family Spy
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. Daniel menyerang Roz kerana dia sangka Roz adalah penculik. Roz cuba melindungi identitinya sebagai seorang perisik.

programme.title: Family Spy

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series. Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie. High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! How can one be the creator of the underwater world? Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt tackles some weighty issues when the fattest parrot he has ever seen pays him a visit, in the sixth programme of the series Matt conducts an emergency caesarean to save the life of Penny the cat, and helps a swan which has been the victim of a brutal mugging.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In London, an underweight, heavily pregnant dog has been brought into the Blue Cross Animal hospital by its owner. The mum to be needs emergency surgery to deliver her pups and because of her poor condition Inspector Annie Simmonds has been called in to investigate. Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets to play matchmaker when three fallow deer trade their bachelor days for life with a 120-strong female deer herd. But first Matt must dart the deer and remove their antlers -V so the pressure's really on. The abandoned baby badger has trebled in size, but back in the surgery, a tiny water dragon is in for a tricky operation. There's good news for two rescued stray cats when they find a luxury new home - and at Flamingoland, Matt lets the ring-tailed lemurs out into their brand new enclosure after a winter spent indoors.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Thornton Heath, South London, Inspector Nick Wheelhouse is called out to see three adult mastiffs and nine puppies who are all drastically underweight. Will Gaza, the mother and the skinniest of the dogs, be able to regain the weight she so desperately needs.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.title: We Knead Pizza
programme.desc: Cancel the pizza delivery, it’s time to save money and build your pies from scratch. With three different pizza styles, you’re bound to find one that satisfies your craving without digging into your wallet.

programme.title: Oktoberfest
programme.desc: Join Frankie as he shares his budget friendly takes on Oktoberfest-inspired dishes, perfect for celebrating the fall season with friends. These festive and hearty meals will keep you cozy and full, and best of all, pair nicely with a beer.

programme.title: European Adventure
programme.desc: Today, we embark on a European Adventure! We'll be visiting the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and Greece to check out their culinary wonders. So what are we waiting for? Let's get to it!

programme.title: Italian Classics
programme.desc: On this episode, we're going to show you some of our favorite Italian classics. Pasta, pizza, and more... you name it, we've got it. So, what are you waiting for? It's time to get cooking!

programme.title: A Trip to Latin America
programme.desc: We hope you brought your passport, because we're heading to Latin America! Whether it's breakfast, lunch, dinner or dessert, we're going to show you some delicious dishes, each with their own unique Latin flair!

programme.title: Viva La Mexico
programme.desc: Today, we'll be exploring cool cuisines from our neighboor south of the border. From breakfast to traditional fare, all the way to guac and salsa, and ending with dessert. We'll showcase some great dishes and let you know which one is our favorite.

programme.title: Pizza Time
programme.desc: Today we've got pizza all day for you: in the morning, in the evening, literally any time you want! Not only will we share some great recipes but we will let you know which ones are our favorites too. What are we waiting for? Let's get to the pizza!

programme.title: Cheese!
programme.desc: Today, it's all about cheese: from the melted gooey-ness to just plain old slices, cheese makes the world go round. We'll showcase recipes that feature cheese in all forms. So strap in, it's time to get cheesy.

programme.title: Comfort Food!
programme.desc: On this episode, it's time to get cozy with some of our favorite Tastemade comfort food recipes. Get cozy and settle in for what's sure to be a mouth-watering journey!

programme.title: Grill It Up

programme.desc: On this episode, it's all about dessert delights! Whether it's made from chocolate or a fruit-filled treat, we've got them all! We'll show you a few for each category, along with our favorite from the bunch. We're having dessert all day today!

programme.title: Party Time Favorites
programme.desc: It's time to host a party! Whether it's for the big game or a fancy dinner party, there are so many options you can make your guests or bring to the potluck. So what are you waiting for? It's party time in the Tastemade kitchen!

programme.title: Salad Salad Salad
programme.desc: Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

programme.title: Potato Variety Show
programme.desc: Today, Frankie’s slicing, mashing and smashing his way through the spud species, an essential staple for any Struggle kitchen. They’ve got so many talents and textures that whichever way you dig ‘em, potatoes will never let you down.

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Pizza Slice, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill throws a pizza party with her delicious homemade pies! She creates a sweet and savory pie with spicy pepperoni & pineapple, a tangy BBQ chicken pizza, a grandma deep dish pie with mozzarella & chorizo, and an herby salad flatbread.

programme.title: Plantains and Rice, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month with her mom’s recipes as well as some of her own. She’ll whip up a coconut coquito cocktail, Cuban-style black beans, a garlicky arroz con pollo with sofrito, and some salty and sweet plantains.

programme.title: Moroccan Lamb with Sangria, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill welcomes the coziness of fall with some fabulous flavors & dishes including Moroccan lamb with dates & harissa, fall sangria with apples & amaretto, garlicky rice pilaf, roasted root vegetables, and crispy cucumber salad. It’s fall y’all!

programme.title: Dessert Delights
programme.desc: On this episode, it's all about dessert delights! Whether it's made from chocolate or a fruit-filled treat, we've got them all! We'll show you a few for each category, along with our favorite from the bunch. We're having dessert all day today!

programme.desc: It's time to host a party! Whether it's for the big game or a fancy dinner party, there are so many options you can make your guests or bring to the potluck. So what are you waiting for? It's party time in the Tastemade kitchen!

programme.title: Southern Home Cooking
programme.desc: Today, we're going on a trip down south for a taste of some country home cooking. Our quest for the best southern dish covers breakfast, lunch, dinner, and of course, dessert. But we better get moving, they're ringing the dinner bell!

programme.title: Dessert Delights
programme.desc: On this episode, it's all about dessert delights! Whether it's made from chocolate or a fruit-filled treat, we've got them all! We'll show you a few for each category, along with our favorite from the bunch. We're having dessert all day today!

programme.title: Party Time Favorites
programme.desc: It's time to host a party! Whether it's for the big game or a fancy dinner party, there are so many options you can make your guests or bring to the potluck. So what are you waiting for? It's party time in the Tastemade kitchen!

programme.title: Asian Fusion
programme.desc: Today, we're getting a taste of some Asian Fusion. From Japan, India, Korea, and Thailand, we're showing off some unique options before landing on our favorite choice from each country. Let's go!

programme.title: Summer BBQ
programme.desc: It's time for some summer fun! Don't worry, we got you covered with some of the best Summertime BBQ around. Fire up your grills and bust out those tongs, because it's time for more Tastemade's Recipe Rundown!

programme.title: Crock Pots and Steamers
programme.desc: Today, we'll be checking out some incredible recipes that can be made in a crock pot or a steamer! From soups to regular meals, even right down to some unconventional ideas, we've got it all. Plug in those crock pots, it's time to get steamy!

programme.title: Eating Vegan
programme.desc: On this episode of Tastemade's Recipe Rundown, we're switching things up and running on pure plant power! That's right, today we're featuring some incredible vegan eats!

programme.title: Spooky Season
programme.desc: The fog is rolling in, which means it's time for the spooky season! But don't you worry, because you'll be able to keep those ghosts and skeletons happy with all the spooky eats and scary treats in this episode of Tastemade's Recipe Rundown!

programme.title: Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it’s Sunday somewhere, right?

programme.title: Perfectly Prepared Steaks
programme.desc: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse.

programme.title: New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po’boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.

programme.title: Beer Brats & BBQ Ribs
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert.

programme.title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you’ve ever eaten.

programme.title: Pizza Party on the Grill
programme.desc: It’s Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: Bougie Badass Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings your basic burgers to a new level with his dry-aged beef burger with potatoes and truffle dijon mayo, a part-beef part-pork belly burger with cheddar & an egg, and lastly a crispy mushroom tortilla burger with salsa & cheese.

programme.title: Smash Burgers & A Slice in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to all the buzzworthy spots in LA - cooking up calamari steak at a classic Mexican joint, tasting taro root donuts with fun flavors, grabbing a guanciale slice, and hopping on the line to make cheesy scrumptious smash burgers.

programme.title: Tacos, Brats, & Biscuits in Austin
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes down south to try Austin’s best bets - breakfast tacos are on the itinerary, as well as a bangin’ beer garden & sausage house, loaded biscuits, and dessert pancakes to boot! Austin may be weird but the food is fabulous.

programme.title: Brooklyn’s Best Pizza Tour
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes on the best pizza party crawl that Brooklyn has to offer. He’ll try a Neo-Neapolitan pie, a classic coal oven favorite, he’ll hit up a modern joint with innovative toppings, and a cozy Italian-owned neighborhood spot.

programme.title: BBQ Bowls & Puffy Tacos in San Antonio
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza gets his spurs on to sample San Antonio’s best all-day brunch, taste some epic puffy tacos at a classic car joint, create colorful conchitas, and bask in the beauty of BBQ Thai curry bowls.

programme.title: Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar.

programme.title: Pierogies, Bagels, and Ramen in NYC
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza takes a LOT of bites out of the big apple as he samples warm pillowy bagels & schmear, grabs pierogies at an old school Ukrainian spot, gets the scoop on innovative ice cream flavors, and slurps up some real ramen.

programme.title: Dumplings, Steam Buns, and Dim Sum, Oh My!
programme.desc: In a city with over 60 Michelin star restaurants, one brother will live and dine like a king, while the other will check out the city’s more affordable street food scene.

programme.title: Simplicity vs. Splendor on the Seaside
programme.desc: Soaking in the beauty and elegance of the French Riviera, Marko and Alex are in Nice to enjoy the simplicity and splendor of this seaside city.

programme.title: Keep Austin Weird
programme.desc: In the state capital of Texas, Marko and Alex see what Austin has to offer. An eclectic city known for its music and cuisine, the guys brave the Texas heat and check out what keeps Austin weird.

programme.title: Levels of Luxury in Laos
programme.desc: Sandwiched between Thailand, Vietnam, and Cambodia, Laos is a destination often overlooked by tourists. Marko and Alex are uncovering the hidden gem of Vientiane, the capital city, to see what goes on in this sleepy town beside the Mekong River.

programme.title: The Gainful Grace of Geneva
programme.desc: Marko and Alex find themselves in the prosperous and pristine city of Geneva, Switzerland. A city nestled alongside a beautiful glacier-fed lake, the guys will explore the riches Geneva has to offer.

programme.title: The Thriving Traditions of Taipei
programme.desc: ​Welcome to the buzzing capital of Taiwan. A rich blend of cultures, old meets new in this thriving metropolis of Taipei. Marko and Alex eat their way through the city, experiencing some unique traditions along the way.

programme.title: The Lion's Share of Lyon
programme.desc: Marko and Alex head to Lyon, France, a city known for its gastronomy and endless history.

programme.title: Oceanside in Okinawa
programme.desc: Ocean breeze, turquoise waters and a whole lot of amazing cuisine. Marko and Alex are soaking up that island life in Okinawa, Japan and learning what makes it so unique.

programme.title: Genoa From Above and Below
programme.desc: In Genoa, the brothers cruise the streets, while one of them gets a taste for the lavish lifestyle of Italy's Northwestern port. They take in all the views: heads in the clouds on a high-flying funicular, and just above water at the local aquarium.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E04 - Operation Justice

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E07 - High Water
programme.desc: 克里斯和凱德被困在帳篷裡幾天，當天氣變好時，終於得到了一段休息。他們意識到降雨導致河流上升至危險水平。儘管如此，他們的獵尋大動物之旅依然持續。.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E08 - Moose Fever
programme.desc: 克里斯和凱德正在追蹤一頭巨大的雄駝鹿，凱德準備開槍。與此同時，凱西和R.L.仍在尋找大型獵物。河水位依然高峻且狂野。.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E07 - Swoop and Scoop
programme.desc: Wiedie y Chris diseñaron sus vidas para poder experimentar todo lo que Jackson Hole tiene que ofrecer. Y cuando el primer paseo en moto de nieve de un joven se descontrola, unen sus fuerzas a las de Jess y Flip para ejecutar un rescate perfecto.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E08 - No Short Cuts
programme.desc: Tim exige mucho de todos los que le rodean, especialmente durante un rescate en una cueva, que él describe como el peor tipo de rescate.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E09 - Gold, Sweat and Dragon's Blood
programme.desc: Tom and Kia explore a mysterious mine in Colorado.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E33 - Prince Edward and Sophie Rhys-Jones
programme.desc: 真實故事將我們帶入一個簡單的皇室愛情故事。它提供了一個王子如何愛上一個普通中產階級女孩的幕後花絮。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. This show takes a closer look at how he got along with his sons, his longtime love Camilla, and what his future might look like as King. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E05 - Operation Wildfire
programme.desc: 在本集Wardens中，我們正在尋找一隻麻煩的熊，它一直在翻找鄰里的垃圾。與此同時，在另一個地方，我們對一群人因無照釣魚而給予罰單。.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E09 - Weary Travellers

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E10 - Lifted

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E01 - Terry's Criminal Mind

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E02 - Shark Go Boom!
programme.desc: In Jaws, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if you can hit, and explode, the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E01 - From There to Here
programme.desc: Con el reciente lanzamiento de la primera nave espacial privada que prestará servicio a la estación espacial internacional, ha llegado el momento de echar un nuevo vistazo a las nuevas fronteras del espacio. El cielo está plagado de estrellas e innumerables galaxias. Con la robótica, las tecnologías avanzadas y la audacia, estamos llegando a donde antes sólo soñábamos.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E02 - Return To The Moon
programme.desc: La Luna, nuestra compañera celeste más cercana. Nuestra indispensable pareja de baile a través del cosmos. Iluminando nuestro cielo nocturno y tirando suavemente de nuestras costas. Pocos han caminado sobre su superficie, aunque su encanto sigue siendo fuerte, una vez más miramos hacia ella con renovado interés y con la intención de volver muy pronto.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E01 - At All Costs
programme.desc: Ivan emprende un viaje para salvar a los diecinueve rinocerontes de su amigo de la epidemia de caza furtiva que azota Sudáfrica. La solución: la pesadilla logística de transportar a toda la manada a un lugar seguro a 600 millas al otro lado del país.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle dan Putera Harry berkongsi minat yang serupa dan nampak seperti pasangan yang sempurna. Keduanya telah menghadapi masa sukar semasa membesar tetapi telah berjaya. Kini mereka sedang berjaya bersama. Istimewa sejam ini, yang menampilkan perbualan dengan penulis Andrew Morton, meneroka latar sosial yang menjadikan perkahwinan beraninya sesuai dengan Keluarga Diraja Britain hari ini.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E08 - The Forgotten Giants
programme.desc: No toda la caza furtiva es por cuernos y colmillos. En muchas partes de África, asolada por la pobreza, las jirafas son asesinadas sin piedad por su carne. programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E01 - Python Invasion
programme.desc: Armado sólo con su ingenio, las herramientas y dispositivos más rudimentarios y cero armadura, el experto en depredadores Manny Puig le guiará a través de algunas de las aguas más turbias y los lugares más peligrosos del planeta. En este episodio, Manny Puig busca serpientes gigantes que han invadido los Everglades.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E02 - Still Waters Run Red
programme.desc: Manny Puig explora el peligro que acecha bajo los canales de Florida.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E03 - Canal Monster
programme.desc: Mientras sigue explorando los canales artificiales de Florida, un enorme caimán ataca a Manny.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E04 - Sharks of the Gulf Stream
programme.desc: Manny atrae a los tiburones más peligrosos de la corriente del golfo.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - SO1:E05 - Volcanic Kingfish
programme.desc: Mario hooks up with old friend and current world record holder for Kingfish, Rick Pollock. They fish the the coast of New Zealand just off a live volcano, then tragedy strikes, after the volcano erupts, Mario returns to catch a whopping Bass Grouper and prepares an amazing ceviche dish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E06 - Mountain Monsters - Red Stag
programme.desc: After being dropped off into the mountains where there were only whispers and tales of mountain monsters being seen. Mario is on the search of the outer limits of the mountains to find himself a monster red deer.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E07 - Boars and Prehistoric Fish
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong. Drama strikes and Mario finds himself in crocodile infested water plucking fish out.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E08 - Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Mario enjoys the camaraderie and challenge of duck hunting on opening day, and then teaches the audience how to cook an ancient Chinese recipe with one of the leading chefs of an award-winning restaurant from New Zealand.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E01 - Texas Mule Deer Part 1
programme.desc: Amid the ancient canyon geology of west Texas run herds of desert mule deer and for Laramy Miller the hunt is on for one special buck.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E02 - Colorado Elk
programme.desc: Las llamadas de los alces resuenan en las montañas donde Laramy está cazando. Al caer la noche, Laramy se pone a tiro de un enorme alce.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E03 - Black Bear
programme.desc: El oso negro de primavera vaga por estas montañas, justo fuera de la vista y más allá del sendero. Con sólo su vieja pistola de pólvora negra como protección, Laramy necesita asegurarse de que ve al oso, antes de que el oso lo vea a él.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E04 - Texas Mule Deer Part 2
programme.desc: Laramy ha aceptado el reto de cazar ciervos mulos salvajes específicos en libertad en Texas.

programme.desc: Mario hooks up with old friend and current world record holder for Kingfish, Rick Pollock. They fish the the coast of New Zealand just off a live volcano, then tragedy strikes, after the volcano erupts, Mario returns to catch a whopping Bass Grouper and prepares an amazing ceviche dish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E06 - Mountain Monsters - Red Stag
programme.desc: After being dropped off into the mountains where there were only whispers and tales of mountain monsters being seen. Mario is on the search of the outer limits of the mountains to find himself a monster red deer.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E07 - Boars and Prehistoric Fish
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong. Drama strikes and Mario finds himself in crocodile infested water plucking fish out.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E08 - Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Mario enjoys the camaraderie and challenge of duck hunting on opening day, and then teaches the audience how to cook an ancient Chinese recipe with one of the leading chefs of an award-winning restaurant from New Zealand.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E01 - Texas Mule Deer Part 1
programme.desc: Amid the ancient canyon geology of west Texas run herds of desert mule deer and for Laramy Miller the hunt is on for one special buck.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E02 - Colorado Elk
programme.desc: Las llamadas de los alces resuenan en las montañas donde Laramy está cazando. Al caer la noche, Laramy se pone a tiro de un enorme alce.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E03 - Black Bear
programme.desc: El oso negro de primavera vaga por estas montañas, justo fuera de la vista y más allá del sendero. Con sólo su vieja pistola de pólvora negra como protección, Laramy necesita asegurarse de que ve al oso, antes de que el oso lo vea a él.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E04 - Texas Mule Deer Part 2
programme.desc: Laramy ha aceptado el reto de cazar ciervos mulos salvajes específicos en libertad en Texas.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E08 - The Forgotten Giants
programme.desc: No toda la caza furtiva es por cuernos y colmillos. En muchas partes de África, asolada por la pobreza, las jirafas son asesinadas sin piedad por su carne. Ivan se une a un equipo especializado para explorar soluciones radicales que permitan a la vez salvar a la jirafa y proporcionar alimentos a las comunidades necesitadas.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E01 - Python Invasion
programme.desc: Armado sólo con su ingenio, las herramientas y dispositivos más rudimentarios y cero armadura, el experto en depredadores Manny Puig le guiará a través de algunas de las aguas más turbias y los lugares más peligrosos del planeta. En este episodio, Manny Puig busca serpientes gigantes que han invadido los Everglades.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E02 - Still Waters Run Red
programme.desc: Manny Puig explora el peligro que acecha bajo los canales de Florida.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E03 - Canal Monster
programme.desc: Mientras sigue explorando los canales artificiales de Florida, un enorme caimán ataca a Manny.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E04 - Sharks of the Gulf Stream
programme.desc: Manny atrae a los tiburones más peligrosos de la corriente del golfo.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait
programme.desc: 黛安娜，威爾士公主，真是令人著迷，並在她的時代留下了與其他女性不同的印記。作為童話公主、關心丈夫的妻子和時尚開創者，這部紀錄片探索了更深的意義，以揭示在持續的公眾關注背後的真實人。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: 當戴安娜訂婚時，她始終處於媒體的視野中。她在一生中專注於自己的兒子，並致力於慈善工作，例如對地雷發表意見。戴安娜利用自己的名氣來引起人們對這些和其他重要問題的關注。這部經過深思熟慮的節目更深入地研究了20世紀最驚人的人物之一。通過前所未見的畫面，它展示了她從一個害羞的少女走到成為威爾士公主戴安娜的歷程，包括她最後日子的感人時刻。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1
programme.desc: 作為皇室妻子，戴安娜與莎拉的生活充滿了孤獨和悲傷，儘管她們懷抱著對於為溫莎家帶來改變的殷切期望。原本該是她們"童話般"的生活，卻最終遠離了這一現實。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E28 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 2
programme.desc: 威爾士公主黛安娜和約克公爵夫人莎拉均嫁入女王的大家族，處於丑聞中心卻以不同方式離開。可惜的是，黛安娜已去世，而莎拉幸存下來，重新開始。隨著時間推移，她們的奮鬥可以得到更好的理解，本紀錄片探討了這些挑戰...

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E06 - Operation Trespass
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲守衛正在注意違反狩獵法律的人，例如擅自闖入、過早狩獵、從汽車獵捕或捕獲尖角麋鹿。.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E01 - Empty Handed
programme.desc: En zonas remotas, la supervivencia es un juego cotidiano. Los anfitriones Chris y Casey Keefer se proponen sobrevivir 30 días en plena naturaleza. Cada nuevo día, estos hermanos enfrentarán sus habilidades como cazadores, leñadores y pescadores a un paisaje implacable y despiadado. DROPPED enfrenta a los espectadores a la dura realidad de que sólo se puede comer lo que se puede matar. Una auténtica prueba de supervivencia.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer despiertan en una tundra helada. Con más de 8 millas por recorrer y sin remos, los hermanos se ven obligados a abrirse camino a través de aguas poco profundas y tierra estéril mientras se dirigen río abajo en busca de su segundo escondite.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E03 - The Good, The Bad and Terry
programme.desc: 在這部經典的西部片中，克林特·伊斯特伍德 - 也被稱為「金髮」 - 三次拯救伊萊·華拉奇免於絞刑架，方法是射擊並切斷他懸掛的繩索。我們重現每個場景，並用所用武器測試這些射擊的現實性。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E04 - Dying Hard
programme.desc: 約翰·麥克林（布魯斯·威利斯）懸掛在一棟大樓的側面。拯救自己的唯一方法是通過玻璃窗射擊並突破安全區。使用同樣的貝雷塔92手槍，我們重建辦公室玻璃，看看我們的主人能否突破。.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E03 - The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: Orbitan entre nosotros y nuestra Estrella, los mundos interiores; ocultos bajo el resplandor del Sol, a menudo sólo visibles al amanecer o al atardecer. Venus, la primera y más brillante estrella del cielo vespertino, y Mercurio, que cruza fugazmente el disco solar. Son la mitad de los planetas terrestres de nuestro sistema solar y, sin embargo, al observar a nuestros compañeros, nos plantean más preguntas que respuestas.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E04 - Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: It has fired our imaginations for millennia, Mars, the God of War and the source of Man's science fictional demise. We know the dry barren planet was once flowing with vast reservoirs of water, the sky thick and filled with clouds and the tantalizing possibility of life. It is the only other place in our solar system than Man might.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E02 - The Heart of the Conflict
programme.desc: Investigando una serie de leones asesinados, Ivan llega al corazón mismo de un antiguo conflicto entre humanos y leones. El resultado pondrá a prueba los propios valores fundamentales de Ivan sobre la cultura.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E33 - Prince Edward and Sophie Rhys-Jones
programme.desc: 真實故事將我們帶入一個簡單的皇室愛情故事。它提供了一個王子如何愛上一個普通中產階級女孩的幕後花絮。.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E06 - Operation Trespass
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲守衛正在注意違反狩獵法律的人，例如擅自闖入、過早狩獵、從汽車獵捕或捕獲尖角麋鹿。.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E01 - Empty Handed
programme.desc: En zonas remotas, la supervivencia es un juego cotidiano. Los anfitriones Chris y Casey Keefer se proponen sobrevivir 30 días en plena naturaleza. Cada nuevo día, estos hermanos enfrentarán sus habilidades como cazadores, leñadores y pescadores a un paisaje implacable y despiadado. DROPPED enfrenta a los espectadores a la dura realidad de que sólo se puede comer lo que se puede matar. Una auténtica prueba de supervivencia.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer despiertan en una tundra helada. Con más de 8 millas por recorrer y sin remos, los hermanos se ven obligados a abrirse camino a través de aguas poco profundas y tierra estéril mientras se dirigen río abajo en busca de su segundo escondite.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E03 - The Good, The Bad and Terry
programme.desc: 在這部經典的西部片中，克林特·伊斯特伍德 - 也被稱為「金髮」 - 三次拯救伊萊·華拉奇免於絞刑架，方法是射擊並切斷他懸掛的繩索。我們重現每個場景，並用所用武器測試這些射擊的現實性。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E04 - Dying Hard
programme.desc: 約翰·麥克林（布魯斯·威利斯）懸掛在一棟大樓的側面。拯救自己的唯一方法是通過玻璃窗射擊並突破安全區。使用同樣的貝雷塔92手槍，我們重建辦公室玻璃，看看我們的主人能否突破。.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E03 - The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: Orbitan entre nosotros y nuestra Estrella, los mundos interiores; ocultos bajo el resplandor del Sol, a menudo sólo visibles al amanecer o al atardecer. Venus, la primera y más brillante estrella del cielo vespertino, y Mercurio, que cruza fugazmente el disco solar. Son la mitad de los planetas terrestres de nuestro sistema solar y, sin embargo, al observar a nuestros compañeros, nos plantean más preguntas que respuestas.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E04 - Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: It has fired our imaginations for millennia, Mars, the God of War and the source of Man's science fictional demise. We know the dry barren planet was once flowing with vast reservoirs of water, the sky thick and filled with clouds and the tantalizing possibility of life. It is the only other place in our solar system than Man might.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E02 - The Heart of the Conflict
programme.desc: Investigando una serie de leones asesinados, Ivan llega al corazón mismo de un antiguo conflicto entre humanos y leones. El resultado pondrá a prueba los propios valores fundamentales de Ivan sobre la cultura.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E33 - Prince Edward and Sophie Rhys-Jones

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E12 - The Keefer Brothers
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer recuerdan uno de sus momentos favoritos de la aventura de este año.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E01 - Into the Unknown
programme.desc: En el estreno de la temporada, los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer llegan a Nueva Zelanda sin prácticamente nada. Deben adaptarse rápidamente a su nuevo entorno o enfrentarse a consecuencias mortales.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E02 - White Water
programme.desc: La adrenalina se ha agotado para Chris y Casey, y el jet lag ha hecho acto de presencia. Los hermanos se enfrentan a temperaturas gélidas e impredecibles rápidos de aguas bravas. Cuando intentan navegar por las aguas bravas, su seguridad se ve amenazada.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E03 - Risk and Reward
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer toman una importante decisión que afecta enormemente a su expedición. En una búsqueda desesperada de los alimentos necesarios, intentan cazar caza mayor por primera vez en Nueva Zelanda, y se encuentran con un nuevo conjunto de desafíos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E08 - Surviving Nature's Fury
programme.desc: Nick Mundt y Laura Schara experimentan la furia de la Naturaleza a través de asombrosos equipos generadores de tormentas que simulan terribles huracanes, vientos helados e incluso tornados. programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E03 - Deadman's Survival
programme.desc: Island Air lucha contra el tiempo y los elementos, para rescatar a un grupo atrapado en Deadman's Bay.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E06 - Training Day
programme.desc: Island Air es el salvavidas de muchos en Kodiak. A veces, las violentas condiciones meteorológicas impiden que los aviones aterricen, así que Erik aprovecha el día para enseñar a Pete a utilizar la escotilla de la cámara para practicar un poco el tiro al blanco.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E01 - Into the High Lonesome
programme.desc: Laramy Sasquatch Miller emprende El Camino con su fiel caballo 7, para poner a prueba sus habilidades de supervivencia y rendir homenaje a los hombres de montaña del pasado. Al despedirse de su familia, Laramy y 7 tienen que luchar contra los elementos, construir refugios, vivir de la tierra y sobrevivir a una travesía de 30 días por el interior del país.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E02 - Camp Otis
programme.desc: El moderno montañero Laramy Miller emprende el camino para experimentar la vida en la alta soledad.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E07 - Operation Summer Recreation
programme.desc: 我們在蒙大拿的西利湖附近，區域2的警衛忙於處理夏季遊客。.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E03 - Choke Point
programme.desc: El terreno empieza a cambiar a medida que los hermanos Keefer se ven obligados a abrirse camino río abajo. El paisaje se estrecha y conduce a los hermanos a un punto geográfico donde se reúnen depredadores y presas.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E04 - Bone Weary
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer se refugian en un pequeño pinar mientras una tormenta invernal asedia el río. Obligados a esperar a que pase el temporal, los hermanos intentan conservar la poca energía que les queda.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E05 - Schapbo
programme.desc: 約翰·蘭博獨自消滅敵人的能力創造了一些好萊塢歷史上最不可思議的武器特技。我們測試這一區塊鏈特許經營的這些標誌性場景的現實。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E06 - Terry And The Minigun
programme.desc: ¿Puedes realmente disparar una GE Minigun a mano con munición sujetada en una mochila (también visto en Depredador (1987)? Además, para una de nuestras pruebas más grandes, ¿puedes realmente talar un bosque de jungla con una Minigun? El actor Bill Duke, que coprotagonizó con Arnold Schwarzenegger en la película y cuyo personaje realizó este stunt de arma, se une a nosotros para averiguarlo. Pero primero, tenemos que construir una jungla.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E05 - The Planet Makers
programme.desc: De los inicios de nuestro Sistema Solar, hace cuatro mil quinientos millones de años, quedan pistas tentadoras sobre su evolución; restos: asteroides y cometas. Su tamaño varía desde granos de polvo hasta laderas de montañas, desde balones de fútbol hasta planetoides. Ahora, a nuestro alcance, estas rocas de hielo y polvo están dispuestas a desvelar sus secretos.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E06 - The Ice Giants
programme.desc: Más allá del cinturón de asteroides se encuentran los gigantes de hielo, algunos pueden verse a simple vista, otros sólo vislumbrados una vez por una sonda de paso. Volvemos a enviar cámaras a los confines del sistema solar, lo que nos ofrece nuevas perspectivas sobre la evolución de nuestros mundos.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E03 - One Rhino at a Time
programme.desc: Mientras visita un orfanato secreto que cuida de crías de rinoceronte rescatadas, Ivan descubre la sangre, el sudor y las lágrimas que se emplean en salvar a esta especie en peligro de extinción. Una llamada de emergencia le lanza a la aventura con un grupo de héroes locales para salvar al próximo rinoceronte huérfano.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
programme.desc: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. Once a princess who wasn't supposed to be queen, Elizabeth II led the country to thrive after World War II and became a steady presence in our changing world. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E04 - Bone Weary
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer se refugian en un pequeño pinar mientras una tormenta invernal asedia el río. Obligados a esperar a que pase el temporal, los hermanos intentan conservar la poca energía que les queda.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E05 - Schapbo
programme.desc: 約翰·蘭博獨自消滅敵人的能力創造了一些好萊塢歷史上最不可思議的武器特技。我們測試這一區塊鏈特許經營的這些標誌性場景的現實。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E06 - Terry And The Minigun
programme.desc: ¿Puedes realmente disparar una GE Minigun a mano con munición sujetada en una mochila (también visto en Depredador (1987)? Además, para una de nuestras pruebas más grandes, ¿puedes realmente talar un bosque de jungla con una Minigun? El actor Bill Duke, que coprotagonizó con Arnold Schwarzenegger en la película y cuyo personaje realizó este stunt de arma, se une a nosotros para averiguarlo. Pero primero, tenemos que construir una jungla.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E05 - The Planet Makers
programme.desc: De los inicios de nuestro Sistema Solar, hace cuatro mil quinientos millones de años, quedan pistas tentadoras sobre su evolución; restos: asteroides y cometas. Su tamaño varía desde granos de polvo hasta laderas de montañas, desde balones de fútbol hasta planetoides. Ahora, a nuestro alcance, estas rocas de hielo y polvo están dispuestas a desvelar sus secretos.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E06 - The Ice Giants
programme.desc: Más allá del cinturón de asteroides se encuentran los gigantes de hielo, algunos pueden verse a simple vista, otros sólo vislumbrados una vez por una sonda de paso. Volvemos a enviar cámaras a los confines del sistema solar, lo que nos ofrece nuevas perspectivas sobre la evolución de nuestros mundos.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E03 - One Rhino at a Time
programme.desc: Mientras visita un orfanato secreto que cuida de crías de rinoceronte rescatadas, Ivan descubre la sangre, el sudor y las lágrimas que se emplean en salvar a esta especie en peligro de extinción. Una llamada de emergencia le lanza a la aventura con un grupo de héroes locales para salvar al próximo rinoceronte huérfano.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
programme.desc: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. Once a princess who wasn't supposed to be queen, Elizabeth II led the country to thrive after World War II and became a steady presence in our changing world. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E34 - Prince William And Prince Harry The Next Royal Generation
programme.desc: Prince William and Prince Harry, along with their friends, got as much media attention as today’s pop stars, fashion icons, and movie celebs. This documentary explores how this affected their personal lives and friendships, showcasing how they managed their fame alongside their royal responsibilities.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E44 - 50 Glorious Years A Royal Celebration
programme.desc: Honoring 50 years of marriage between Her Majesty the Queen and her husband, Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark, the Duke of Edinburgh.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E08 - Operation Rocky Mountain Front
programme.desc: 在狩獵季節，野生動物管理員透過用麋鹿誘餌抓捕盜獵者，追踪闖入者並檢查狩獵標籤，保持警覺。.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E05 - Fireside Fortune
programme.desc: Utilizando sus últimas energías, los hermanos Keefer se dirigen río abajo en busca de su siguiente alijo. La marea cambia cuando finalmente logran salir de la tundra abierta y entrar en el corazón del territorio de los alces.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E06 - Now or Never
programme.desc: Con los ánimos levantados, los hermanos Keefer se disponen a avistar y acechar una manada de caribúes cercana, pero acercarse resulta más difícil de lo esperado.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E07 - Scoreless
programme.desc: Utilizando un método único para abrir una caja fuerte, Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) utiliza un soplete para cortar a través de una caja fuerte, la llena de agua y hace estallar la puerta con un pequeño dispositivo explosivo. Probamos esto, junto con los efectos de un rifle antitanque de 20 mm en una caja fuerte de la película Thunderbolt and Lightfoot.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E08 - Terry Vs Gorn
programme.desc: 特里和拉里在紐約上州的星際迷航原始系列拍攝場地進行測試。他們發現自己在USS Enterprise上，並測試柯克是否可以用竹管、鎂粉和石刀及皮革製造一門大炮。在星際迷航中它成功了，但這真的會有效嗎？.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E07 - The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. Some have oceans of water, geysers of Sulphur or atmospheres of plastic. Some are just now being seen at the outer rim of our solar system, all are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E08 - The Sun
programme.desc: Impulsa la maquinaria de la naturaleza; nuestro clima, fomenta y sostiene la vida en la tierra y en el mar. Cuando se pone por el Oeste, nos revela los miles de millones de estrellas hermanas que pueblan el cielo nocturno. Estudiamos nuestro Sol de cerca y, como una piedra Rosetta, puede revelarnos los secretos de todas las demás estrellas.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E04 - Elephant Country
programme.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers who have been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1
programme.desc: 作為皇室妻子，戴安娜與莎拉的生活充滿了孤獨和悲傷，儘管她們懷抱著對於為溫莎家帶來改變的殷切期望。原本該是她們"童話般"的生活，卻最終遠離了這一現實。.

programme.title: Pocket Dial Murder
programme.desc: 故事跟隨史黛西，她接到丈夫的誤撥電話。在電話的另一頭，她聽到一名女子的死訊。當她丈夫回家時，他說他的手機不見了。.

programme.title: Dare to Say Yes
programme.desc: 米歇爾正度過最糟糕的一天——同一天被解雇並被甩。最好的朋友莎拉說服她去参加一個新的靜修會，該靜修會提供一個名為勇敢說是的健康和賦權計劃。.

programme.title: My Killer Reunion
programme.desc: 克莱尔和詹姆斯是一对已婚夫妇，他们前往医学院校友会，与老同学摩根重聚。然而，摩根迷恋詹姆斯，决心要将他占为己有，试图在此过程中破坏克莱尔的生活。.

programme.title: A Royal Makeover
programme.desc: When Ramone discovers he is the heir to the European Kingdom of San Pablo, he is daunted by the prospect of becoming king. Royal expert Angelica is hired to transform Ramone into the king he is destined to be.

programme.title: Snowkissed
programme.desc: 一位不喜愛旅行的記者追逐她夢寐以求的任務，在那裡她很快就成為一位渴望成為導遊的英俊B&B業主的導師。.

programme.title: A View to Kill For
programme.desc: 莫莉和她的家人繼承了她遙遠父親的豪宅後，搬到了高尚的社區。然後，有人闖入並在他們的牆上塗寫了一個可怕的消息。.

programme.title: Our Mother's Secret Affair
programme.desc: 黛安娜·帕克發現她家中的入侵者實際上是她的親生女兒，幾年前她將其交給了領養。當他們努力重建彼此的關係時，他們遇到了一個危險的威脅 - 一個無情的殺手，將不惜一切代價阻止他們重聚，即使這意味著謀殺。.

programme.title: Lies My Babysitter Told
programme.desc: Carnie決定重返工作，最終雇用了鄰居的兒子Matt來照顧她的2歲孩子。她的丈夫Nick對這個主意不太高興。沒過多久，一個秘密浮出水面。.

programme.title: A Deadly Mistake
programme.desc: 平面設計師四月發生車禍，讓她的男友派屈克陷入昏迷，她因此受到恐慌發作的折磨。但她的新男性朋友是否有隱藏的企圖？.

programme.title: Danger Rocks the Cradle
programme.desc: Nicolette, a high school senior has bounced around from foster home to home. She started feeling hopeless when found herself pregnant by the school quarterback.

programme.title: Kidnapped to the Island
programme.desc: 一位渴望成為流行歌手的星粉少女失踪，她關心的單親媽媽出發拯救她，免遭那位引誘她來遙遠小島的控制性歌手的掌控，該歌手以名聲和財富為誘惑。.

programme.title: The Love Advisor
programme.desc: Abby works as an assistant and writer of the popular podcast run by her former college friend Serena. Journalist comes from NYC to write about podcast and Serena. Abby starts to develop feelings, but Serena already has a plan for herself.

programme.title: The Wedding Contest
programme.desc: 當一對夫婦無法決定婚禮主題時，他們雇了兩位婚禮策劃師，泰勒和本，讓他們透過提出兩種截然不同的風格來競爭這份工作。.

programme.title: Danger Rocks the Cradle
programme.desc: Nicolette, a high school senior has bounced around from foster home to home. She started feeling hopeless when found herself pregnant by the school quarterback.

programme.title: How To Frame A Family
programme.desc: No information available.

programme.title: Sister Dating Swap
programme.desc: 當姊妹海倫娜和瑞秋對她們的愛情和工作感到厭倦時，她們同意交換住所兩周。然而，這場假期卻讓她們對工作、生活，最重要的是對戀愛有了全新的看法。.

programme.title: Loving Every Minute
programme.desc: When Stephanie inherits a watch, she learns that it allows her to travel back in time five minutes, once a day. But as she uses it more and more, her life, and romance with her coworker Hunter, doesn't shake out the way she hoped.

programme.title: Living Next to Danger
programme.desc: 慈善始於家庭，這句話是Roxanne Robinson重新思考的內容，當她的青春女兒失踪時，所有人開始責怪最近搬進她家後院的鄰居，他們看似完美的房子。.

programme.title: Mystery Island
